use_when: to identify the Cozy Corner brand on a page or screen.
Use the full logo (glyph and wordmark) wherever there is room, such as the Header and Footer.
Use the glyph only in tight spaces, such as a collapsed Sidebar.
Use the wordmark only when the glyph already appears nearby.
Use the Website platform for customer-facing pages and the Dashboard platform for dashboard screens.
Use the logo on light backgrounds.

dont_use_when.when: as a decoration or a repeating background pattern.
if it needs to be stretched, rotated or recolored.
with both the glyph and the wordmark turned off.
Do not place other elements inside the clear space.

best_practice: Keep the clear space free on every side.
placement: Header and Footer (full logo); a collapsed Sidebar (glyph only).

a11y.fact: With the wordmark hidden, the glyph alone is exposed as an image named "Cozy Corner" (role="img", aria-label).
The glyph SVG is hidden from assistive tech.
